# Generated by tools/freeze_constraints.sh. Do not edit by hand.
#
# Every package in the ingest's own venv (/opt/upto/venv), pip included, at the version the airflow
# image installs it. The Dockerfile passes this file to both pip installs as `-c`, so a rebuild
# installs the same set as today's. Airflow's own packages come from the base image and are
# pinned by its tag, not by this file.
#
# **After changing a pin or adding a package in airflow/Dockerfile, re-freeze:** run
# tools/freeze_constraints.sh, read the diff it prints, and commit both files. A bumped pin that
# disagrees with this file makes the build refuse. A NEW package is not refused, only left
# unconstrained, which is why `tools/freeze_constraints.sh --check` compares the built image with
# this file.
